# Mix 94.9 Cincinnati

> Mix 94.9 is Cincinnati's premier radio station featuring 80s, 90s, 2000s and today's music with live shows, podcasts, contests, and community events.

Mix 94.9 Cincinnati serves the local radio market with a diverse lineup of on-air personalities, music programming, and event coverage. The station focuses on classic hits from multiple decades combined with current music and active community engagement through contests, galleries, and local event promotion.
